% ============================================================
% CV PREAMBLE (design only). Single column, ATS-safe. Page count set per user in lanes.md.
% Assemble: cat preamble.tex payload/header.tex content.tex > CV.tex && tectonic CV.tex
% header.tex (generated by /payload-setup) carries \begin{document} + the name block.
% content.tex starts at \section{Summary} and ends with \end{document}.
% Fonts: Charter via fontspec; swap \setmainfont if Charter is missing on your system.
% ============================================================
\documentclass[10pt,a4paper]{article}

\usepackage[margin=1.5cm,top=1.3cm,bottom=1.3cm]{geometry}
% ATS safety: fi/fl ligatures render as U+FB01/U+FB02 in the PDF text layer and
% many resume parsers do not normalise them ("fulfillment" -> "fulﬁllment"), so
% the keyword silently fails a recruiter search. microtype's \DisableLigatures
% is pdfTeX/LuaTeX-only and a no-op under tectonic's XeTeX, so Charter is loaded
% through fontspec with Ligatures=NoCommon instead. Same typeface, greppable text.
\usepackage{fontspec}
\setmainfont{Charter}[Ligatures=NoCommon]
\usepackage{enumitem}
\usepackage{titlesec}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\definecolor{linkblue}{RGB}{20,80,160}
\hypersetup{colorlinks=true,urlcolor=linkblue,linkcolor=linkblue}
\usepackage{microtype}
\usepackage{parskip}
\usepackage{needspace}

\definecolor{rulegray}{gray}{0.55}
\definecolor{headblue}{RGB}{20,45,90}

% Section: small caps, thin rule underneath, tight spacing
\titleformat{\section}
  {\large\bfseries\color{headblue}}{}{0pt}
  {\MakeUppercase}[{\vspace{-6pt}\color{rulegray}\rule{\textwidth}{0.4pt}}]
\titlespacing*{\section}{0pt}{14pt}{5pt}

% Tight bullets
\setlist[itemize]{leftmargin=1.1em,itemsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,topsep=2pt,
  label={\textbullet}}

% Role line: bold title/company left, gray dates right
\newcommand{\role}[3]{%
  \Needspace*{4\baselineskip}
  \par\vspace{4pt}\noindent\textbf{#1} \textbar{} #2 \hfill
  {\small\color{rulegray}#3}\par\vspace{1pt}}

% Project line: bold name left, gray date right, tech line under
\newcommand{\proj}[3]{%
  \Needspace*{5\baselineskip}
  \par\vspace{4pt}\noindent\textbf{#1} \hfill {\small\color{rulegray}#2}\par
  {\small\itshape #3}\par\vspace{1pt}}


% Tech stack line under a role header, same rendering as \proj's tech line
\newcommand{\stack}[1]{{\small\itshape #1}\par\vspace{1pt}}

% Never orphan a section header at a page bottom
\let\origsection\section
\renewcommand{\section}[1]{\Needspace*{10\baselineskip}\origsection{#1}}
\pagestyle{empty}
% Single space after full stops (LaTeX defaults to a wider inter-sentence gap)
\frenchspacing
